extDescription.message: A music player for Minecraft. Simpler and smoother.

importNotice.message: To use the player, you must import the game songs in Settings first.

guideIntro.message: You need the assets folder from your Minecraft installation.

guideSelect.message: Select the root assets folder (the one containing "indexes" and "objects").

optAutoplayDesc.message: Play music when the browser opens.

optDelayDesc.message: Time to wait before the music starts when the browser opens.

optStartupRandomDesc.message: Start with a random track (following your random mode) instead of resuming the last one.

optGapDesc.message: How long to wait before the next track starts.

optComposerDesc.message: Random modes only play tracks by this composer.

errNoIndex.message: Error: No .json file found in the 'indexes' folder. Make sure you have selected the game's 'assets' folder.

errBadJson.message: Error: The index file is not a valid JSON.

errBadFormat.message: Error: The index does not have the expected format (missing 'objects').

errNoTracks.message: Error: No music files found. Make sure the folder contains 'objects' with the game sounds.

loadingWaiting.message: ⏳ Waiting for the folder... reading it can take a moment.

poolEmptyComposer.message: No tracks by $1 in "$2", so nothing will play. Change the random mode or the composer filter.

poolEmptyBanned.message: Every track in "$1" is banned, so nothing will play.

filterTitle.message: Random modes only play this composer. Click to change it.
